_comment: plugin-forge is a static dev tool — its enforcement point is CI (lint --all --strict), not a session Stop-hook. SessionStart health-check only. Hooks use EXEC form (command + args, no shell) so a path with spaces needs no quoting; each script starts with a python>=3.8 guard that no-ops with a message. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to this plugin's install location.
